name: Patch Management & Vulnerability Assessment
description: Assessment of OS patch management posture and vulnerability management processes. Covers patch currency evaluation across Windows (Windows Update for Business, Autopatch, Configuration Manager and Intune, with WSUS deprecated for new features), Linux (apt, yum, zypper), and macOS (Software Update, MDM), vulnerability scanning methodology, patch impact and risk analysis, zero-day exposure assessment, and patch management process maturity evaluation.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to patch management assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands patch management principles and vulnerability assessment concepts
evidence: Can explain patch management lifecycle and common update mechanisms
Understands CVSS scoring, vulnerability prioritization, and risk-based patching
Familiar with vulnerability scanning tools and their limitations
Completed introductory training on vulnerability management

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Runs vulnerability scans and reviews patch posture under supervision
evidence: Runs Nessus, Qualys, or equivalent vulnerability scanners under guidance
Reviews patch currency reports for Windows and Linux systems
Identifies missing critical and high-severity patches using scan results
Documents vulnerability findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses patch management and vulnerability posture across platforms
evidence: Independently assesses patch posture across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments
Evaluates Windows Update for Business, Configuration Manager and WSUS, apt/yum, and MDM patch distribution effectiveness
Contextualizes vulnerability findings by exploitability, exposure, and compensating controls
Produces actionable patch management assessment reports with risk-based prioritization

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Evaluates complex patching environments; assesses process maturity
evidence: Assesses patch management process maturity against industry frameworks
Evaluates complex environments with mixed OS, legacy systems, and air-gapped networks
Develops vulnerability management KPIs and patch SLA recommendations
Reviews junior analysts' vulnerability assessment work

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab vulnerability assessment methodology; advises on patch strategy
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's patch management assessment framework
Advises organizations on vulnerability management program design
Trains teams on advanced vulnerability assessment and patch risk analysis
Recognized as authority on vulnerability management best practices

assessment_methods.description: Assess the patch management posture of a mixed OS environment and produce a risk-prioritized vulnerability report with remediation timeline recommendations
Review vulnerability assessment findings and patch management recommendations from recent engagements

cis: CIS Controls v8.1 - Control 7 (Continuous Vulnerability Management)
